suiteEvidence.supersedes: verified-live-execution report after accounting fixture correction

routingReport.boundary: Small fixed functional pilot. Models/fixtures/criteria fixed before first run; no general routing quality/cost claim. No private prompts or credentials.

pilot.boundary: Small fixed functional pilot; not a blind benchmark or a general quality/cost/latency/promotion claim. Rule, six inputs and exact oracles unchanged across protocol revisions. Uniform domain-shaped schemas and 2048 output cap/zero temperature for all modes. Fast-only quality is measured, not required perfect.
pilot.costScope: Registry model-token estimates; external fees and development/diagnostic runs excluded from this comparison, not hidden from validation provenance. All per-trial calls, failures, repairs, thinking and unknowns are included in the full snapshots.
pilot.toolContract: First read required through existing public host hook, then tools disabled; exact read count/result and selected model checked. This is not a prompt-compliance quality assertion.

amos.commands: /routing set/use/hints/rule/off + inspection; saved JSON host rules; actual decisions for run/stream; helpers and routing independent; native and async replacement protected

resolvedValidationIncidents.problem: Google returned 53 instead of 23 in the existing main thinking-accounting fixture; transport/usage accounting succeeded.
resolvedValidationIncidents.resolution: Set zero temperature on both helper and main, and require checking the original three congruences/minimality. Expected answer 23 and all token/cost/reasoning assertions remain unchanged; thinking/output budgets are unchanged. The complete 14-test affected suite passes after correction; all earlier diagnostic failures remain in their reports.

resolvedValidationIncidents.problem: Main structured repair could lose the original task/evidence without selection/native history.
resolvedValidationIncidents.resolution: Retain the admitted sanitized frame and host instructions; same selected route/task/fit checks, no second prepare. Regression with routing enabled/disabled and actual controlled provider repair.

resolvedValidationIncidents.problem: Anthropic native source count rejected terminal assistant whitespace as generation prefill.
resolvedValidationIncidents.resolution: Count in compaction operation mode, matching actual reduction. Preserve the exact source, no trim/fabricated message. Unit and real native save/restore pass.

resolvedValidationIncidents.problem: Native wrapper initially overwrote source guard; reservation observers could change source after initial check.
resolvedValidationIncidents.resolution: Compose native/route guards, recheck after reservation including retries, pin only actual dispatch. No reduction/charge for stale source.

resolvedValidationIncidents.problem: Async continuation needed originating structured format/task and cleanup.
resolvedValidationIncidents.resolution: Retain binding, task and formatting on authentic followup; fit-checked source-preserving repair; clear per-run settings on settlement. Suspension/cancel/teardown regressions included.

resolvedValidationIncidents.problem: Initial live fixture setup used saveSession return as ID and unsupported OpenAI native hard cap.
resolvedValidationIncidents.resolution: Use getSessionId; cap main only through supported hooks. No endpoint promises or production restrictions weakened.

resolvedValidationIncidents.problem: Initial pilot output protocol underspecified scalar forms and used too-small cap; a cheap-only baseline incorrectly assumed perfect quality.
resolvedValidationIncidents.resolution: Uniform protocol revision 2 frozen before final run: same inputs/oracles/rule, domain scalar patterns, integer controlled-repair schema, temp0 and 2048 pilot cap. Cheap-only errors measured; main/routed exact predicates and >=5% cost target unchanged. No answer oracle added to a prompt/schema.

resolvedValidationIncidents.problem: Google returned schema-valid PENDING without the requested read in the initial transport fixture.
resolvedValidationIncidents.resolution: Required first read using the existing host tool-choice hook and disabled later tools. All vendors must still pass actual read/result/route assertions; prompt compliance is not claimed.

resolvedValidationIncidents.problem: AMOS negative test table spread argument arrays; a public stream mock omitted text deltas.
resolvedValidationIncidents.resolution: Correct real command argument cases and emit actual text deltas. All new public/AMOS controls pass.

resolvedValidationIncidents.problem: Sandbox prevented local HTTP fixture and CLI IPC/cache writes.
resolvedValidationIncidents.resolution: Authorized local-fixture/build executions, Node import loader where applicable, and /tmp npm cache with pack scripts disabled after verified build. Not counted as library failures or skipped validation.

resolvedValidationIncidents.problem: Generated API TOC used punctuation collapsing inconsistent with heading anchors.
resolvedValidationIncidents.resolution: Fix generator anchor formation and regenerate the API reference; verify documentation links rather than hand-edit generated output.
